standard_prerequisites.name: A complex K' whose derived reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal is pseudo-coherent is itself pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the pseudo-coherence half of relative perfectness.

standard_prerequisites.name: A complex K' whose derived reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal has finite tor dimension has finite tor dimension itself
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the finite tor dimension half of relative perfectness.

core_obligations: The kernel of A' -> A is the image of the nilpotent kernel of R' -> R, hence nilpotent, and by the flatness of R' -> A' the objects A' and R are tor independent over R', so K = K' tensor_{A'}^L A equals K' tensor_{R'}^L R (proof lines 22173-22176). Since K is R-perfect, it is pseudo-coherent and of finite tor dimension over R; by the check-pseudo-coherent-modulo-nilpotent lemma K' is pseudo-coherent over A' (with finite type map R' -> A'), and by the check-tor-dimension-modulo-nilpotent lemma K' has finite tor dimension over R' (proof lines 22176-22177). The two halves give that K' is R'-perfect (proof lines 22177-22177).
proof_roadmap: Identify K with the derived reduction of K' and note the nilpotent kernel (proof lines 22173-22176).
Lift pseudo-coherence and finite tor dimension through the nilpotent thickening (proof lines 22176-22177).
